id.description: Unique identifier, e.g. `"core:meet_needs"`. Namespaced ids are the modding convention; overrides replace by id after mod layering.

methods.description: Ordered decomposition methods (tried in declaration order).

parameters.description: Parameter names this compound accepts at call sites. A step referencing this compound may pass `"args": { "<param>": <value> }`; inside the compound body, `{"param": "<name>"}` markers are substituted with the bound value at compile time. Each distinct (task, arguments) specialization compiles as its OWN graph node.

HtnCallDef.description: A native-predicate reference: which kernel to compile, with its raw arguments. The kernel owns its argument schema — this layer stores the JSON verbatim.

args.description: Raw kernel arguments (schema-validated by the kernel at compile time).

id.description: Method name — the override/diagnostic handle. Overrides target named methods; explicit declaration order is preserved.

steps.description: Subtask steps in declaration order (a pure `then` chain).

when.description: Preconditions — all must hold for this method to be chosen. Each is a native-predicate reference; unknown predicate names are compile errors.

HtnStepDef.description: One step of a method body: a native operator, a sub-task reference, or a `bind` step (a later extension — parsed but uninterpreted for now).

args.description: Named operator/task arguments (raw; kernels validate their own).

task.description: Referenced compound task by definition id.
